mappings.description: Stable AskSocial intake identifier; not an official regulatory case identifier.
mappings.extractionMethod: Assigned by AskSocial on record creation.
mappings.notes: Never present this value as a worldwide unique case identifier.

mappings.description: Sender-assigned safety report identifier.
mappings.condition: Required for an E2B ICSR message; not assigned by AskSocial.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text in the verified ICH format.
mappings.extractionMethod: Supplied by the client safety system.
mappings.unavailableHandling: omit from AskSocial notification; blocks E2B-export-ready
mappings.notes: AskSocial must not manufacture a regulatory sender identifier.

mappings.description: Creation date of the E2B message, not the AskSocial record.
mappings.condition: Required only when a downstream system creates an E2B message.
mappings.extractionMethod: Assigned by the downstream safety system at message generation.
mappings.notes: Must not be copied from algorithm or review timestamps.

mappings.description: Origin category of the report.
mappings.extractionMethod: Machine suggestion from source context, confirmed by PV reviewer using CL2 version 2.11.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown; use verified CL2 handling only during transformation
mappings.notes: January 2026 package includes the revised report/study alignment; do not freeze codes in application logic.

mappings.displayName: Date report first received from source
mappings.description: Sender's first-receipt date for the report.
mappings.condition: Client receipt policy must confirm whether AskSocial collection or notification constitutes receipt.
mappings.extractionMethod: Candidate from collectedAt under an explicit client-approved receipt rule.
mappings.notes: REGULATORY VERIFICATION REQUIRED per client/region; collectedAt is retained independently.

mappings.description: Date of the latest information included in the case.
mappings.condition: Calculated from verified case/follow-up evidence by the receiving safety system.
mappings.extractionMethod: Maximum timestamp among human-accepted evidence and follow-ups.
mappings.notes: Must not automatically equal updatedAt.

mappings.description: Whether sender-held additional documents are available.
mappings.extractionMethod: Reviewer confirms retained screenshots or attachments.
mappings.unavailableHandling: false only when reviewer confirms none; otherwise unable_to_determine
mappings.notes: Document content remains in the evidence store.

mappings.description: Whether the case fulfils local criteria for expedited reporting.
mappings.condition: Determined by responsible PV organisation under applicable regional rules.
mappings.unavailableHandling: NI only when allowed by active rule package
mappings.notes: AskSocial does not determine reportability.

mappings.description: Official worldwide case identifier.
mappings.condition: Assigned/retained by the responsible sender system.
mappings.notes: Never derive from AskSocial Case ID.

mappings.description: Type of organisation that first transmitted the case.
mappings.notes: AskSocial is an intake service, not presumed first regulatory sender.

mappings.description: Prior identifiers associated with the same case.
mappings.extractionMethod: Confirmed case relationship and client-supplied identifier.
mappings.unavailableHandling: omit when no previous transmission is known
mappings.notes: Possible matches remain relationships and are not populated here until confirmed.

mappings.description: Identifiers of reports linked to this report.
mappings.condition: A qualified reviewer confirms a supported report relationship.
mappings.notes: Never destructively merge source mentions.

mappings.description: Reporter title when explicitly and permissibly available.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; verified nullFlavors MSK, ASKU, NASK, UNK
mappings.unavailableHandling: not_reported; transform to nullFlavor only under active business rules
mappings.notes: Privacy minimization applies.

mappings.description: Reporter given name when explicitly and permissibly available.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; verified nullFlavors MSK, ASKU, NASK
mappings.extractionMethod: Verbatim extraction only; never resolve a handle into a real identity.
mappings.notes: Do not expose unnecessary PII in email.

mappings.description: Reporter family name when explicitly and permissibly available.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; verified nullFlavors MSK, ASKU, NASK
mappings.notes: Privacy minimization applies.

mappings.description: Reporter organisation explicitly present in source.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; verified nullFlavors MSK, ASKU, NASK
mappings.notes: Public profile claims do not prove identity.

mappings.description: Reporter country code when explicitly supported.
mappings.condition: Per the C.2.r reporter business rules.
mappings.extractionMethod: Normalize explicit location; do not infer from language alone.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown; apply nullFlavor only if permitted
mappings.notes: REGULATORY VERIFICATION REQUIRED for regional conformance.

mappings.description: Reporter qualification category.
mappings.condition: Required within a populated primary-source block.
mappings.extractionMethod: Classify only from explicit source/profile evidence and confirm using CL6.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown under verified C.2.r business rule
mappings.notes: A digital handle alone is insufficient to establish an identifiable reporter.

mappings.description: Marks the primary regulatory source when multiple sources exist.
mappings.condition: Required when more than one primary source is recorded.
mappings.notes: Do not auto-select based on source prominence.

mappings.description: Bibliographic reference for literature reports.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU or NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: Do not treat every news/blog source as literature.

mappings.description: Public study registration identifier.
mappings.condition: Report is from a study and identifier is explicit.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU or NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: Retain registration country separately.

mappings.description: Name of the study.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU or NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: No inferred study title.

mappings.description: Study type where reaction/event was observed.
allowedValues: 6 Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform
mappings.extractionMethod: Suggest from explicit source context and validate against active CL8.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown only under verified CL8/business rule
mappings.notes: This is CL8 v2.1 in the January 2026 package and must remain configuration-driven.

mappings.description: Permissibly retained patient name/initials; minimized for privacy.
mappings.condition: Required in E2B; null handling may apply.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; MSK, ASKU, NASK, UNK where permitted
mappings.extractionMethod: Verbatim only; prefer minimized initials and redact unnecessary PII.
mappings.unavailableHandling: not_reported internally; transform only under active rules
mappings.notes: Do not derive identity from a username.

mappings.description: Date of birth explicitly stated.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; MSK where permitted
mappings.extractionMethod: Exact extraction only; no age-to-DOB calculation.
mappings.notes: Privacy minimization applies.

mappings.description: Age number at reaction/event onset.
mappings.condition: Age unit D.2.2b must accompany the value.
mappings.extractionMethod: Extract explicit age; date arithmetic only with verified dates.
mappings.notes: Conflicting ages must remain conflicting and block auto-finalization.

mappings.description: Unit paired with patient age.
mappings.extractionMethod: Normalize explicit unit to active UCUM configuration.
mappings.notes: Unit code is loaded from configuration, not application conditionals.

mappings.description: Age group as reported.
mappings.extractionMethod: Map explicit source language to CL9; do not infer a narrower group than supported.
mappings.notes: Preserve original phrase in evidence.

mappings.description: Patient body weight in kilograms.
mappings.extractionMethod: Extract explicit value; convert unit only by deterministic configured conversion.
mappings.notes: Retain source value/unit in evidence.

mappings.description: Patient height in centimetres.
mappings.extractionMethod: Extract explicit value; convert only by deterministic configured conversion.
mappings.notes: Retain source unit.

mappings.description: Patient sex as supported by source evidence.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown; use verified nullFlavor if transformed
mappings.notes: Do not infer from name, avatar, or generic product audience.

mappings.displayName: Relevant medical history and concurrent conditions
mappings.description: Relevant history and concurrent conditions in free text.
mappings.condition: Structured D.7 history is present or the applicable business rule requires text/null handling.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; MSK, ASKU, NASK, UNK where permitted
mappings.notes: No clinical facts may be introduced.

mappings.description: Patient date of death when explicitly reported.
mappings.notes: Fatal cases always require human review.

mappings.description: Reaction/event wording in the primary source's native language.
mappings.extractionMethod: Verbatim span extraction; never overwrite with coded term.
mappings.notes: Multiple events must remain separate.

mappings.description: Language of native reaction/event verbatim.
mappings.extractionMethod: Configured language detection with reviewer override.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown; blocks E2B-export-ready for that event
mappings.notes: Store detector/version provenance.

mappings.description: Version of MedDRA used for event coding.
mappings.condition: A coded MedDRA event is included in downstream E2B.
mappings.unavailableHandling: do not emit MedDRA code; blocks E2B-export-ready
mappings.notes: AskSocial has no global default MedDRA version.

mappings.description: Human-validated MedDRA reaction/event code.
mappings.condition: A reaction/event block is exported downstream.
mappings.allowedValues: Numeric MedDRA code from configured licensed version
mappings.extractionMethod: Machine suggestion may be retained separately; only human-validated code enters this field.
mappings.notes: Never label machine suggestions as validated coding.

mappings.description: Event-level fatal seriousness criterion.
mappings.extractionMethod: Flag from explicit evidence, confirmed by reviewer.
mappings.notes: Never infer death from severity language.

mappings.description: Event-level life-threatening seriousness criterion.
mappings.notes: Clinical severity and regulatory seriousness are distinct.

mappings.description: Hospitalisation seriousness criterion.
mappings.notes: An emergency visit does not automatically establish admission.

mappings.description: Disability/incapacity seriousness criterion.
mappings.notes: Requires human PV interpretation.

mappings.description: Congenital anomaly seriousness criterion.
mappings.notes: Pregnancy exposure alone does not establish this criterion.

mappings.description: Other medically important event seriousness criterion.
mappings.notes: AI cannot finalize this criterion.

mappings.description: Start date/time of reaction/event.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; MSK, ASKU, NASK where permitted
mappings.extractionMethod: Extract explicit date or preserve imprecise temporal phrase outside this field.
mappings.notes: Relative time-to-onset is not silently converted to a calendar date.

mappings.description: End date/time of reaction/event.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; MSK, ASKU, NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: Ongoing outcome is not an end date.

mappings.description: Numeric duration paired with configured unit.
mappings.condition: Duration unit E.i.6b accompanies the value.
mappings.extractionMethod: Explicit duration or deterministic calculation from validated dates.
mappings.notes: Retain derivation inputs.

mappings.description: Outcome at the time of last observation.
mappings.extractionMethod: Map explicit source outcome and confirm using CL11.
mappings.notes: Existing internal hospitalization outcome is a seriousness signal, not an E.i.7 outcome code.

mappings.description: Whether event was medically confirmed by a healthcare professional.
mappings.notes: Reporter HCP status alone does not prove confirmation of each event.

mappings.description: Country where the reaction/event occurred.
mappings.notes: Do not substitute reporter/account location.

mappings.description: Date of relevant test/procedure.
mappings.condition: A test result block is included.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; UNK where permitted
mappings.notes: Uncommon in social evidence but structurally supported.

mappings.description: Test/procedure name in free text.
mappings.notes: Preserve source wording.

mappings.description: Unstructured test result text.
mappings.condition: Unstructured result is the supported result representation.
mappings.notes: Structured values/units map to F.r.3.2/F.r.3.3 when explicitly supported.

mappings.description: Role of product in the case.
mappings.extractionMethod: Suggest from context; reviewer confirms using CL13.
mappings.notes: Do not assume every named product is suspect.

mappings.description: Product name exactly as reported by source.
mappings.notes: Keep normalized match separate.

mappings.description: Active substance/specifed substance name when verified.
mappings.extractionMethod: Versioned product dictionary lookup; retain dictionary/version.
mappings.notes: Do not infer from an uncertain brand match.

mappings.description: Numeric dose.
mappings.notes: Never infer dose.

mappings.description: Unit paired with numeric dose.
mappings.allowedValues: Constrained UCUM / dose-form codes from active package
mappings.notes: Configuration owns code mapping.

mappings.description: Therapy start date/time.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; MSK, ASKU, NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: Never infer therapy dates.

mappings.description: Date/time of last administration.
mappings.allowedValues: ICH date format; MSK, ASKU, NASK where permitted
mappings.notes: Never infer therapy dates.

mappings.description: Product batch or lot number.
mappings.notes: Do not mistake order/reference IDs for lot numbers.

mappings.description: Source-faithful dosage description.
mappings.notes: No inferred regimen.

mappings.description: Dose form in free text.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU, NASK, UNK where permitted
mappings.notes: EDQM coded form requires separate verified terminology configuration.

mappings.description: Route in free text.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU, NASK, UNK where permitted
mappings.notes: Never infer route from product form alone.

mappings.description: Indication as reported by source.
mappings.allowedValues: Free text; ASKU, NASK, UNK where permitted
mappings.notes: Never infer indication from therapeutic area.

mappings.description: Action taken after reaction/event.
mappings.extractionMethod: Map explicit action wording and confirm.
mappings.unavailableHandling: unknown only under verified code-list rule
mappings.notes: No inferred dechallenge.

mappings.description: Result of an attributed causality assessment.
mappings.condition: Assessment source and method are also retained.
mappings.extractionMethod: Preserve reporter statement separately from reviewer/medical assessment.
mappings.notes: Temporal language does not establish medical causality.

mappings.description: Rechallenge outcome.
mappings.notes: Do not infer rechallenge from repeated use without event recurrence evidence.

mappings.description: Coded additional product circumstances such as overdose.
mappings.condition: A configured CL17 condition is supported.
mappings.extractionMethod: Special-situation suggestion confirmed by reviewer and mapped via active code list.
mappings.notes: Special-situation detection does not itself determine reportability.

mappings.description: Factual narrative including clinical course, measures, outcome, and relevant information.
mappings.extractionMethod: Evidence-grounded summary that attributes causality and preserves uncertainty.
mappings.notes: Must not introduce facts absent from source evidence.

mappings.description: Comments attributable to reporter.
mappings.notes: Do not insert AskSocial interpretation.

mappings.description: Comments made by the regulatory sender.
mappings.notes: AskSocial must not represent its generated text as sender medical comments.

mappings.description: When the author originally published the mention.
mappings.extractionMethod: Source metadata / mapped CSV post-date column.
mappings.notes: Not automatically an E2B receipt date.

mappings.description: When AskSocial acquired or ingested the content.
mappings.notes: May be a C.1.4 candidate only under explicit client-approved policy.

mappings.description: When automated classification completed.
mappings.notes: Independent of collection time.

mappings.description: When a reviewer chose Continue to structured review.
mappings.extractionMethod: Server timestamp on governed review-start action.
mappings.notes: Do not prepopulate.

mappings.description: When reviewer saved the governed assessment.
mappings.notes: Independent of review start.

mappings.description: When the reviewer determined the record should enter sponsor handoff.
mappings.notes: Day Zero logic remains governed separately by client/regional policy.

mappings.description: When the configured provider accepted the client notification for delivery.
mappings.extractionMethod: Server timestamp after successful delivery-provider response.
mappings.unavailableHandling: remain blank when only a draft/export was prepared
mappings.notes: Do not mark notification on provider failure.

mappings.description: Per-field source span, extraction method, confidence, model/prompt versions, and review status.
mappings.extractionMethod: Captured with each extracted or reviewed field.
mappings.unavailableHandling: block externalization of unsupported regulatory values
mappings.notes: Required for defensible audit/provenance.

mappings.description: FDA regional elements and conformance rules supplied by a downstream validated safety system.
mappings.condition: Only when FDA is the intended receiver and client configuration enables a verified regional package.
mappings.notes: REGULATORY VERIFICATION REQUIRED before any FDA E2B transformation; this implementation does not generate FDA submission XML.
